deploy.on_merge: Nothing: the Cloudflare Pages project `thekingdom` has no Git provider, so merging deploys nothing
deploy.after_deploy: Manual redeploy (DOMAINS-SETUP.md, Redeploy): from a clean exact commit, `bun bin/stage-hub.ts <empty dir>`, then `node doors/hub/brand/check.mjs --served <that dir>`, then the wrangler publish that runbook names. Check the new paths on the deployment's pages.dev URL first (artcraft-brand wiring.md §2: the custom domain can cache an HTML answer under a new path), then each icon and the card live, and that the shared Worker answers. HTML answers `no-cache, no-transform` (observed 2026-11-05); how long icon files stay cached is not recorded
deploy.rules: DOMAINS-SETUP.md: a production redeploy needs separate approval. The hall's head assets ship only in the door release, which has not been decided. Generated pages are never hand-edited: change bin/build-dashboard.ts and regenerate site/ (CLAUDE.md)

notes: Path: doors/hub/brand/, beside doors/we-are/brand/. Here 'hub' means thekingdom.dev, not the kingdom-os-hub repository (kingdom.ai-love.cc).

One host, several looks: / and /meet/, /citizens/, /join/ are the hall (written by bin/build-dashboard.ts), /atlas.html is the atlas (site/hub.html, written by bin/build-hub.ts), and Power Atlas and /os have looks of their own. site.html checks the four hall pages against the kit, and pins the atlas to its own theme-color pair and scheme (icons not compared: it declares a blank data: icon), so the kit can't re-dress it.

Serving: the hub is staged from an allowlist, publications/hub-staging.v1.json, by bin/stage-hub.ts. The four files under serve.files are contract entries mapping doors/hub/brand/kit/web/<file> to <file>, all mutable destinations. The manifest and its three PNG icons are held (serve.omit), so check.mjs warns that the pages lack the kit's manifest link while adoption is pending, and fails once pending is cleared: ship them, or record the choice, before the release. Pages on this host that declare no icon (/os and others) will find /favicon.ico at the root.

The card: kingdom-os-hub's media/og-atlas.jpg ('ready for https://thekingdom.dev/', committed in b1c8e1bf on 2026-08-17 by git author cambridgetcg, maker not recorded, its plate from an image model per tools/compose-og.py) was compared and not used: it shows the ✦ star the agents' call set aside, a violet nebula and Fraunces, which are the atlas's look, not the hall's night green, brass and seal. The kit's own og.jpg is set in the hall's words on its ground.

Guards: tests/dashboard.test.ts holds the hall's head to kit/web/head-snippet.html (less the held manifest link) and the staging contract to the kit's files; tests/hub-brand.test.ts runs check.mjs. Both run in the verify job of .github/workflows/immutable-publications.yml (bun test --timeout 15000, the whole suite), which names neither file.

verify passed 270 checks with 2 warnings (rebuild of 2026-11-11): the night-green tile is close to a dark browser's tab strip (1.02:1 and 1.31:1); the brass seal on it reads there. The favicon cuts are the generator's own hinting of the small cut (mark/k-seal-small.svg); none is hand-drawn. The small cut's arch is 34 units wide at 10x so the hinting draws it 1, 2 and 3 px on every side at 16, 32 and 48 px (checked pixel by pixel on 2026-11-11; with the earlier 28-unit arch the 32 px cut drew its top and bottom 2 px against 1 px sides). At 16 px the generator now takes the plain small mark, not its bolder fallback, so the K there is lighter than before.

Before a release (2026-11-11): the staging gate's question on the held manifest and its icons (serve.omit) must be settled, because check.mjs fails on the four pages' missing manifest link once serve.pending is cleared. The gate itself is left as it is. The 32 px favicon's uneven arch, the other blocker found in review on 2026-11-10, was fixed at the source on 2026-11-11 (see the verify note).
